methodology: Only Git-tracked files at the pinned phase4 delivery revision; raw working bytes checked against Git blob IDs. Physical lines include blank lines/comments; binary archives excluded from LOC. Native DUT set is native.f plus recursively resolved literal include headers. No reference/generated/history HDL is counted as native implementation; no phase5 draft files.
review: Independent area_report review read Git blobs at the pinned revision; active HDL and test HDL counts agree exactly.
interpretation: Counts describe source-file organization and physical text size, not unique modules, independent tests, original authorship or percent of Python functionality migrated. This statistics JSON and its companion Markdown report are not included in the pinned-revision totals.
